[[The Mindsquall]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Veturni Mindsquall]], a [[boss]] in [[Magus Stones]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[Domination Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves skill recharge of [[Domination Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same model as the [[Wooden Chakram]] and [[Inscribed Chakram (wooden)]]. 
* However, it has a unique appearance because the cloth features a dark red color, whereas the non-unique [[skin]]s cannot be dyed and have a desaturated purple, rather lavender-colored cloth.
* [[Yammiron's Focus]] also uses this model with a unique coloring, featuring a slightly brighter red tone on the cloth.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Inscribed Chakram]] from collectors [[Axton]], [[Claw Tallfeather]], [[Goran Grimyak]], or [[Rylan Paval]] or crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Domination Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Inscribed Chakram]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Aptitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Forget Me Not]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
[[Droknar's Domination Focus]] and [[Hanaku's Focus]] have stats identical to this item.
